readings.mountain: label h is HB h MT; confirmed by Torus (FACTS heatmap_readings)
readings.utc: sensitivity only, not for stage: MT hour = (h - 6) mod 24

oct27.inputs_used: bundle CAISO day-ahead forecasts and prices (the engine's inputs), not EIA-930 actuals

parameters.jam: price at or over the day's max minus 25% of its range

rules.netload_p75: every hour at or above the season's 75th percentile of net load
rules.ours: ours: the 4 highest net-load hours plus every jam hour
rules.top4_netload: the 4 highest net-load hours only (ours without the jam part)
